name: Purgaven
source:
A visual novel about Åke, a swedish art student that goes to Russia to flee his problems, even tho it won't get better. He will meet Olezka, a priest of a secluded church that will provide him help and care. Although it will also be the start of a fall into the abyss for Åke...

[From [url=https://calcax.itch.io/purgaven-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于阿克的视觉小说，阿克是一名瑞典艺术学生，他前往俄罗斯逃避他的问题，尽管情况不会好转。他会遇到奥莱兹卡，一位僻静教堂的牧师，将为他提供帮助和照顾。尽管这也将是阿克坠入深渊的开始……

[来自[url=https://calcax.itch.io/purgaven-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
